verdict_reason: Port renumber to 8089 is consistent with application.yml and compose.yml, but the new dev-run stage has no build path or src bind mount so its advertised hot-reload usage does not work.

todos.issue: New dev-run stage is unreachable: compose.yml uses 'build: ./' with no 'target: dev-run' and no ./src:/app/src bind mount, and the workspace stack has no address-book service, so the advertised hot-reload loop never runs and the stage/docker/dev-run.sh are dead weight
todos.fix: Add a dev override (or compose 'target: dev-run' plus a './src:/app/src' volume) and register address-book in scripts/stack/run-stack.sh, or drop the stage until the stack wiring lands

todos.issue: HEALTHCHECK hardcodes port 8089 in all three runtime stages (lines 52, 86, 117) while the adjacent comment and application.yml declare the port configurable via PORT; setting PORT to anything else makes the container permanently unhealthy and blocks any depends_on: service_healthy
todos.fix: Use the shell-form expansion already available: CMD curl -f http://localhost:${PORT:-8089}/health || exit 1
